top_signals.title: Gold Swings Lower as Fed Tilts Hawkish After Raising Rates
top_signals.summary: Gold swung lower after Federal Reserve officials signaled another rate-increase is likely this year, after raising on Wednesday for the first time in three years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump donor Harold Hamm's Continental Resources to develop oil region in Venezuela
top_signals.summary: Continental said it undertook an "independent evaluation of opportunities" in Venezuela after President Donald Trump called for the industry to invest.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: City pop wasn’t really a genre. Until it was.
top_signals.summary: The internet's city pop revival transformed a once-nebulous label into a global sound.
